tasks.label: sim-git-status
args: cd f:\git\halow-demo; git status --short; git --no-pager log --oneline -6

tasks.label: sim-diff-stat
args: cd f:\git\halow-demo; git --no-pager diff --stat; echo '--- untracked sizes ---'; git status --short | Select-String '^\?\?'

tasks.label: tmp-hd-probe
tasks.command: cmd /c "where make & where riscv-none-elf-gcc & make --version & where sh"

tasks.label: tmp-serial-probe
tasks.command: cmd /c C:\Python313\python.exe -c "import serial,serial.tools.list_ports as lp; print('pyserial', serial.__version__); [print(p.device, '|', p.description) for p in lp.comports()]"

tasks.label: tmp-ui-dir
tasks.command: chcp 65001 | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem F:\git\halow-demo\simulator\tools\ui -Force | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; '=== 顶层 images/'; Get-ChildItem F:\git\halow-demo\images | Select-Object -First 12 -ExpandProperty Name

tasks.label: tmp-halow-ui-owners
tasks.command: chcp 65001 | Out-Null; foreach ($p in 8899,9001,9000) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($x in $c) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $x.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $cl = (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ("ProcessId=" + $x.OwningProcess)).CommandLine; 'port ' + $p + ' pid=' + $x.OwningProcess + ' start=' + $proc.StartTime + ' cmd=' + $cl } }

tasks.label: tmp-halow-ui-kill
tasks.command: chcp 65001 | Out-Null; foreach ($p in 8899,9001,9002,9011,9012) { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { '停 pid=' + $_.OwningProcess + ' （占 ' + $p + '）'; Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; '=== 现在还有谁在听'; foreach ($p in 8899,9001,9002,9011,9012) { if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { '  ' + $p + ' 还在' } }

tasks.label: tmp-halow-ui-kill2
tasks.command: chcp 65001 | Out-Null; for ($i=0; $i -lt 4; $i++) { foreach ($p in 8899,9001,9002,9011,9012) { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; '=== 剩谁在听（应为空）'; foreach ($p in 8899,9001,9002,9011,9012) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { '  ' + $p + ' pid=' + ($c | ForEach-Object { $_.OwningProcess }) -join ',' } }; '=== python 进程'; Get-Process python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,StartTime

tasks.label: tmp-halow-doc-img
tasks.command: chcp 65001 | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem F:\git\halow-demo\simulator\docs -Filter *.png -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Length; '=== 全仓 png（非 .git）'; Get-ChildItem F:\git\halow-demo -Recurse -File -Filter *.png -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\.git\\' } | Select-Object -First 20 -ExpandProperty FullName

tasks.label: tmp-halow-docimg-track
tasks.command: chcp 65001 | Out-Null; Set-Location F:\git\halow-demo; git ls-files simulator/docs | Select-Object -First 10; '=== git status'; git status --short | Select-Object -First 20

tasks.label: tmp-ui-readme-links
tasks.command: chcp 65001 | Out-Null; Set-Location F:\git\halow-demo\simulator\tools\ui; '=== 目录'; Get-ChildItem . -Name; '=== README 里的相对链接/图片'; Select-String -Path README.md -Pattern '\]\(([^)#]+)' -AllMatches | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches } | ForEach-Object { $p = $_.Groups[1].Value; $ok = Test-Path $p; "{0,-6} {1}" -f $ok, $p }

tasks.label: tmp-tasksjson-diff
tasks.command: chcp 65001 | Out-Null; Set-Location F:\git\halow-demo; git rev-parse --show-toplevel; '=== diff stat'; git --no-pager diff --stat -- .vscode/tasks.json; '=== 新增 label 数量'; (git --no-pager diff -- .vscode/tasks.json | Select-String -Pattern '^\+\s+"label"').Count; '=== 文件总行数 / 任务总数'; (Get-Content .vscode/tasks.json).Count; (Select-String -Path .vscode/tasks.json -Pattern '"label"').Count
